Scoring notes:
• To earn the first point a response must state 0 f ′ = or equivalent. Listing the zeros of f ′ is not
sufficient.
• A response that presents any error in evaluating f at any critical point or endpoint will not earn the
justification point.
• A response need not present the value of ( ) 1 f − provided 1 x = − is eliminated because it is the
location of a local maximum. A response need not present the value of ( ) 6 f provided 6 x = is
eliminated by reference to part (a) or eliminated through analysis.
• A response need not present the value of ( ) 8 f provided there is a presentation that argues
( ) 0 f x ′ ≥ for 2 x > and, therefore, ( ) ( ) 8 2 . f f >
• A response that does not consider both endpoints does not earn the justification point.
• The answer point is earned only for indicating that the minimum value is 1. It is not earned for
noting that the minimum occurs at 2. x =
